subject: Request: Conditional pilot credits + milestone criteria
messages:
From: Sana Patel <sana@olivelabs.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: pilot credit + two-week extension for demo sprint

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Olive Labs loved the latency profile on the convo demos. We're prepping a short internal pilot for customer-facing workflow automation and wanted to ask if Redwood can provide a conditional pilot credit and a two-week trial extension.

High level ask:
- $12k in credits applied to the pilot account
- Trial extended by 14 days from the standard 30-day period

We can commit to a short set of milestones (performance checks, integration review, and a readiness call). I attached a one-pager with the pilot scope.

Is this something you can approve from the partnership program or do we need a managed approval?

Best,
Sana
Partnerships | Olive Labs
attachments: olive_pilot_onepager.pdf
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: Sana Patel <sana@olivelabs.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: pilot credit + two-week extension for demo sprint

Marcus / Monica — forwarding Olive's ask. Quick thoughts:

- Olive looks like a solid fit (pilot has clear customer use cases).
- They want $12k credits + 14-day extension. We can do conditional credits tied to milestones; lower risk if we gate the full amount on acceptance criteria.

Possible structure:
1) Initial $4k upfront to cover integration and test runs.
2) $4k after passing perf & latency SLOs (we define test harness).
3) Final $4k after successful readiness call and short customer demo.

Monica — can you confirm the perf test we should require and whether two-week extension is OK operationally (billing/entitlement)? Marcus — if approved, we should record as a promo allocation under DEAL-2026-1847 and set renewal triggers.

Thanks,
Vanessa
Director, Startup Programs
Redwood Inference
From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: pilot credit + two-week extension for demo sprint

Vanessa / Marcus — ops & CS notes:

- Two-week extension: fine from an entitlement perspective. We'll mark the account as extended-trial and add an internal note for billing to prevent auto-charge.
- Perf criteria suggestion (minimal, pragmatic):
  * Sustained 95th percentile latency < 400ms for typical chat flows (50 token context)
  * Throughput >= 10 req/s with continuous batching for 30m run
  * No regression on hallucination score on internal eval (>0.8 quality threshold)

- I can own building the perf harness and validating results; will need access to their staging keys and a short SLA on test windows (2 business days to run full suite).

I'll draft the milestone checklist and share the file.

— Monica
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: Sana Patel <sana@olivelabs.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 08:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: pilot credit + two-week extension for demo sprint

All — happy with Monica's technical criteria. From a commercial perspective, I recommend this conditional structure but include a short clause: if Olive commits to a paid tier within 90 days of pilot completion, we release a final 20% bonus credit ($2.4k) as an incentive.

Also suggesting we log this as a promo allocation (code: OLIVE-PILOT-08-26) and get a signature on a short MOU outlining the milestones and data handling (SOC2 scope).

If we agree, Vanessa — can you sign off and I'll push the promo in the billing console and create the HubSpot line item?

Marcus
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Sana Patel <sana@olivelabs.ai>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: pilot credit + two-week extension for demo sprint

Hi Sana — thanks again and welcome back. We can approve a conditional pilot credit and the requested trial extension with the following mutual action plan:

Mutual Action Plan (summary):
- Trial extension: +14 days from their current trial expiration. Redwood will flag Olive's org for extended trial entitlement.
- Credits: $12,000 total, released in three tranches: $4k upfront, $4k on passing perf tests, $4k on successful readiness demo.
- Perf criteria (as validated by Redwood SE): 95th pctl latency < 400ms (50 token context), throughput >= 10 req/s sustained for a 30m run, and basic quality check (internal eval > 0.8).
- Incentive: If Olive converts to a paid plan within 90 days of pilot completion, Redwood will apply an additional $2,400 bonus credit.
- Deliverables: Monica will run perf validation and provide a short report; Marcus will provision promo allocation OLIVE-PILOT-08-26 and add a HubSpot line item (DEAL-2026-1847).
- Paperwork: Please review and sign the attached MOU (DocuSign link included).

I've attached the Redwood MOP and a draft MOU. Once we have signed MOU, Marcus will push credits and Monica will schedule the validation window.

Next steps:
1) Sana to confirm acceptance of the milestones and sign the MOU.
2) Redwood to provision initial $4k credit within 48 hours of signature.

Looking forward — excited to get Olive running.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Startup Programs
Redwood Inference
